Package arztis.econnector.common.utilities

Class BaseServiceStubPool

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.utilities.BaseServiceStubPool
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
IheServiceStubPool
public class BaseServiceStubPool
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
This class serves as pool for all created SOAP Services. This is a base class. Therefore all services can be set up at program start.
In the basis service stub pool there are services for the SVC
  • AUTH Service
  • BASE Service
  • GINA Service
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
